intro.zh: 以下為本港提供復康器材租借服務的非牟利機構資料，供有需要短期使用器材的病人及家屬參考。租借前請自行向機構查詢現貨供應、實際價格、按金及運費。職業治療師的推薦不涉及任何利益關係。
intro.en: Non-profit organisations in Hong Kong that rent out rehabilitation equipment, for patients and families who need equipment for a short period. Please contact the organisation directly to confirm availability, current fees, deposits and delivery charges before renting. Recommendations by occupational therapists involve no commercial interest.

其他器材（助行器、洗頭機、助聽器等）請參閱官方價目表

Optional occupational therapist assessment: home visit $1,300 / at centre $800 (Subsidy A $80, Subsidy B $480)
Other equipment (walking aids, hair-washing devices, hearing aids, etc.) — see the official price list

notes: 亦可購買二手器材，例如輪椅 $400–$2,000、電動醫護床 $5,000 起、便椅 $300 起（便椅暫不租借）
按金及租期細節請致電或 WhatsApp 查詢
notes_en: Second-hand equipment is also for sale, e.g. wheelchair $400–$2,000, electric nursing bed from $5,000, commode from $300 (commodes currently not for rent)
Please call or WhatsApp for deposit and rental period details

organisations.address_en: B3, G/F, Lok Nin Garden, 188 Tonkin Street, Sham Shui Po, Kowloon

organisations.eligibility_en: Patients and persons with disabilities in Hong Kong; borrowers arrange their own transport to collect and return equipment
organisations.equipment_intro: 普通器材可免費借用首 2 個月、電機及重型器材首 3 個月，其後按月收取租金（最多租用 6 個月）。借用前須以現金繳付按金及一次性清潔費；租金會在按金內扣減。
organisations.equipment_intro_en: General equipment is free for the first 2 months and electrical / large equipment for the first 3 months; monthly rent applies afterwards (up to 6 months). A cash deposit and one-off cleaning fee are paid before borrowing; rent is deducted from the deposit.
notes: 借還時間：星期一至五 上午 9:30–12:30、下午 2:30–5:00（星期六、日及公眾假期休息）
整段借用期普通器材不可超過 8 個月、電機及重型器材不可超過 9 個月；器材損毀按維修費在按金內扣減
申請表格可於協會網頁下載或填寫網上表格
notes_en: Collection / return: Mon–Fri 9:30am–12:30pm and 2:30–5:00pm (closed Sat, Sun and public holidays)
Total period cannot exceed 8 months (general) or 9 months (electrical / large); repair costs for damage are deducted from the deposit
Application form available on the association's website (download or online form)

notes: 辦理手續時須出示租用者／保證人身份證、保證人住址證明，並繳付按金及租金；非本地居民按金為 $1,000–$2,000
部分器材只在總部及部分交收中心提供；可選擇付費器材到戶服務
綜援受助人可保留單據向社會福利署申請醫療復康用品津貼（由社署獨立審批）
notes_en: Bring the user's / guarantor's HKID, the guarantor's proof of address, deposit and rent; deposit for non-local residents is $1,000–$2,000
Some items are available only at the headquarters and selected centres; paid home-delivery service is available
CSSA recipients may keep the receipt to apply for the SWD medical / rehabilitation appliance grant (assessed independently by SWD)

Late return without notice: $60 per day

bathing.title: 上門沖涼／助浴服務
bathing.intro: 病人出院後如在家沖涼有困難，可考慮以下途徑。政府資助服務須先經社署「安老服務統一評估機制」評估及輪候，非即時；自費平台可較快安排，但須自行比較收費。以下資料核對日期為 2026-10-08，實際安排請直接向機構查詢。
bathing.intro_en: If bathing at home is difficult after discharge, consider the options below. Government-subsidised services require a Standardised Care Need Assessment and a waiting period; self-financed platforms can usually start sooner but fees should be compared. Checked on 2026-10-08; please confirm arrangements directly with each organisation.

groups.label: 政府資助家居照顧服務（須統一評估，輪候較長）
groups.label_en: Government-subsidised home care (assessment and waiting list required)

services.name: 體弱長者家居照顧服務（荃灣及葵青區服務隊）
services.name_en: Home Care Service for Frail Elders (Tsuen Wan & Kwai Tsing teams)
services.who: 60 歲或以上、居於社區、經社署「安老服務統一評估機制」評估為適合社區照顧或院舍照顧的體弱長者。服務包括個人照顧（可包括協助沐浴）、基本及特別護理、復康運動、家居清潔、膳食、護送等，服務隊按個別需要訂定內容及次數。
services.who_en: Community-dwelling frail elders aged 60+, assessed under the SWD Standardised Care Need Assessment as suitable for community or residential care. Services include personal care (may include bathing assistance), nursing, rehabilitation exercise, home cleaning, meals and escort; the team sets the content and frequency.
services.apply: 向醫務社會服務部（住院病人可找病房醫務社工）、長者地區中心／鄰舍中心或綜合家庭服務中心申請，由該單位安排統一評估及轉介。社署查詢熱線 2343 2255。2026 年 4 月 1 日起「綜合家居照顧服務（體弱個案）」及「改善家居及社區照顧服務」已合併為此服務。
services.apply_en: Apply through the Medical Social Services Unit (in-patients: ward medical social worker), a District Elderly Community Centre / Neighbourhood Elderly Centre or an Integrated Family Service Centre, which arranges the assessment and referral. SWD hotline 2343 2255. From 1 April 2026 the former IHCS (frail cases) and EHCCS were merged into this service.
services.fee: 按服務使用者經濟狀況按比例收費，並可能每年調整；詳情向服務隊查詢。
services.fee_en: Charged on a sliding scale according to the user's financial situation and may be revised annually; ask the team for details.
services.wait: 須經評估及輪候，輪候人數多，不適合救急。
services.wait_en: Assessment and waiting list required; many people are waiting, so not suitable for urgent needs.

groups.label_en: Community Care Service Voucher for the Elderly (CCSV)

services.name: 社區券 — 向認可服務單位購買到戶個人照顧（包括協助沖涼）
services.name_en: CCSV — buy home-based personal care (including bathing assistance) from recognised providers
services.who: 經統一評估為身體機能中度或嚴重缺損、正在資助長期護理服務中央輪候冊輪候而未接受院舍或資助社區照顧服務的長者。社署會按輪候冊次序發信邀請；收到邀請後可用紙本或「長者服務券資訊系統」（VISE）申請，一般 4 星期內審批。
services.who_en: Elders assessed as moderately or severely impaired, on the Central Waiting List for subsidised long-term care and not yet receiving residential or subsidised community care. SWD invites eligible elders by letter; apply on paper or via the VISE online system, normally approved within 4 weeks.
services.apply: 社署社區照顧服務券辦事處：3107 3013（星期一至五 9:30–13:00、14:30–17:00），電郵 ccsv@swd.gov.hk。持券後可自選荃葵青區認可單位，例如：仁濟樂在家 2615 8202（到戶照顧，info@happyhome.org.hk）、仁濟醫院陳馮曼玲睦鄰社區服務中心 3126 9155（日間中心＋到戶）、長者家 2708 9060、安心醫護 Anycare 5175 8156。
services.apply_en: SWD CCSV Office: 3107 3013 (Mon–Fri 9:30am–1pm, 2:30–5pm), ccsv@swd.gov.hk. Voucher holders choose any recognised unit serving Tsuen Wan / Kwai Tsing, e.g. Yan Chai Happy Home 2615 8202 (home-based, info@happyhome.org.hk), YCH Chan Feng Men-ling Centre 3126 9155 (day care + home-based), Home for the Aged 2708 9060, Anycare 5175 8156.
services.fee: 2026-27 年度服務組合面值每月 $4,526 – $10,824，長者按經濟狀況共同付款 5%／8%／12%／16%／25%／40%，餘額由政府支付。到戶起居照顧員收費例子（長者家 2026 年 4 月價目表）：1 小時 $252、2 小時 $440、3 小時 $510。
services.fee_en: 2026-27 package value $4,526 – $10,824 per month; the elder co-pays 5% / 8% / 12% / 16% / 25% / 40% by means test and the Government pays the rest. Example home PCW rates (Home for the Aged, April 2026 price list): 1 hour $252, 2 hours $440, 3 hours $510.
services.wait: 收到申請後一般 4 星期內審批；未有券者須先經評估及輪候冊邀請，需時較長。
services.wait_en: Applications are normally approved within 4 weeks; without a voucher, assessment and a waiting-list invitation come first, which takes longer.

仁濟醫院陳馮曼玲睦鄰社區服務中心

groups.label: 自費上門照顧平台（可較快安排）

services.name: Toby 長者照顧（上門護理員／起居照顧員）
services.who: 任何有需要人士，網上直接下單，毋須評估；服務包括協助沖涼、如廁、換片、扶抱等，需自備浴椅。
services.who_en: Anyone; book directly online without assessment. Includes bathing, toileting, diaper change and transfers; please have a shower chair at home.
services.apply: 網上預約（hellotoby.com）或致電 3703 3250；最快 3 小時內配對，每次由 3 小時起。
services.apply_en: Book online (hellotoby.com) or call 3703 3250; matching within about 3 hours, minimum 3 hours per booking.
services.fee: 起居照顧員 $103／小時起、保健員 $110／小時起（平均約 $160／小時）；非 9:00–18:00 時段每小時加 $20，星期日加 $5／小時，公眾假期每次加 $30。
services.fee_en: PCW from $103/hr, health worker from $110/hr (average about $160/hr); +$20/hr outside 9am–6pm, +$5/hr on Sundays, +$30 per visit on public holidays.
services.wait: 網上下單後最快 3 小時內收到配對通知。
services.wait_en: Matching notice within about 3 hours of booking online.

services.name: 樂活易 Caring Elderly（社企配對平台）
services.who: 任何有需要人士（不限 65 歲以上），毋須政府評估；個人衛生清潔包括協助洗澡、換尿片。
services.who_en: Anyone in need (not limited to 65+), no government assessment; personal hygiene includes bathing and diaper changes.
services.apply: 網上填表、WhatsApp 或致電 2117 6760，由個案主任評估及配對；配對完成前免費，上門前付款。
services.apply_en: Online form, WhatsApp or call 2117 6760; a case officer assesses and matches. Free until matched; payment before the visit.
services.fee: 按醫護職級逐小時收費（網站顯示實際金額），連續時數越長每小時越平；晚間／凌晨及偏遠地區另加。
services.fee_en: Hourly rates by staff grade (shown on the website); longer bookings cost less per hour; surcharges for night-time and remote areas.
services.wait: 最快 2 小時後上門，建議最少提前一天。
services.wait_en: As fast as 2 hours; at least one day's notice recommended.
services.source_label: 樂活易上門照顧服務頁

services.name: 安心醫護 Anycare（醫護配對；社區券認可單位）
services.who: 任何有需要人士；可派起居照顧員、保健員、護士上門；亦接受社區券。
services.who_en: Anyone; dispatches PCWs, health workers and nurses; also accepts CCSV.
services.apply: 致電 5175 8156 查詢及訂立個人護理方案。地址：九龍荔枝角青山道 479 號麗昌工廠大廈 803 室。
services.apply_en: Call 5175 8156 to enquire and set up a care plan. Address: Room 803, Lai Cheong Factory Building, 479 Castle Peak Road, Lai Chi Kok.
services.fee: 按職級及時數報價，請致電查詢。
services.fee_en: Quoted by staff grade and hours; please call.

services.name: 長者家 Home for the Aged（上門沖涼服務；社區券認可單位）
services.name_en: Home for the Aged (home bathing service; CCSV-recognised)
services.who: 行動不便或臥床長者、剛出院人士；由護理員／保健員上門協助洗澡，有特殊護理需要可安排護士。
services.who_en: Elders with limited mobility or bedridden, recently discharged; carers / health workers assist with bathing, nurses available for special needs.
services.fee: 市場參考：單次上門洗澡約 $300 – $600；護士級可逾 $800。社區券價目（2026 年 4 月）：起居照顧員 1 小時 $252、2 小時 $440、3 小時 $510。
services.fee_en: Market reference: about $300 – $600 per bathing visit; over $800 for nurse level. CCSV price list (April 2026): PCW 1 hour $252, 2 hours $440, 3 hours $510.
services.source_label: 長者家上門沖涼服務介紹及社署認可單位價目表
services.source_label_en: Home for the Aged bathing service page and SWD price list

groups.label: 免費慈善計劃（臥床／臨終人士）

services.name: 毋忘愛「沖滿愛」原床溫水助浴服務先導計劃
services.name_en: Forget Thee Not — "Bath of Love" in-bed warm-water bathing pilot
services.who: 社區內行動不便、體弱長期臥床人士或長者，以及剛出院的長者。由註冊護士帶領兩名助浴員上門，在原床鋪設防水浴槽以溫水洗頭沖涼，每次約 30–45 分鐘。
services.who_en: Community-dwelling bedridden or frail persons and recently discharged elders. A registered nurse and two bathing assistants bathe the person in their own bed using a waterproof bath trough with warm water, about 30–45 minutes per session.
services.apply: 致電 3488 4933 或 WhatsApp 9175 1433 查詢申請方法；先導計劃由 2025 年 9 月起推行，名額及每人服務次數有限。
services.apply_en: Call 3488 4933 or WhatsApp 9175 1433 to ask how to apply. The pilot started in September 2025; places and sessions per person are limited.
services.fee: 先導計劃期間費用全免（施永青基金資助）。
services.fee_en: Free during the pilot (funded by the Shih Wing Ching Foundation).
services.source_label: am730 報道（2025 年）及毋忘愛網頁
services.source_label_en: am730 report (2025) and Forget Thee Not website
